scope: Static findings for the supplied Mavericks and Mojave builds; candidates require rendering qualification before global use.
localEvidence: Source/Build/mavericks-appearance/design-static-evidence.json contains input hashes, selected disassembly, method inventories and constants. Apple binaries and generated disassembly remain local.

confirmed: The original Dock has DOCKGlassFloorLayer and DOCKReflectionLayer; the inspected Mojave Dock uses Dock.FloorLayer and ECMaterialLayer.
Mojave's SLSSetMagicMirrorProperties implementation returns zero without doing work. The inspected SkyLight export table lacks the old mirror creation, space and opacity functions.
Original icon reflections have their own image-processing pipeline, separate from WindowServer's background/window mirror.

DOCKReflectionLayer initializes image-layer opacity to approximately 0.315. setImage: uses GradientBlurFilter, then CIColorControls with contrast 1.45, brightness 0.2 and saturation 1.0. Padding changes the reflection image bounds and reflectionScale.
dock.nextSpike: Reconstruct and qualify the original icon processing and placement against recovered reflection images. Do not treat a vertical flip plus a fade, or a no-op mirror export, as equivalent.
dock.remaining: Background/window reflections require a replacement compositor path; icon pipeline parity alone does not implement them.

confirmed: HIToolbox's _HIMenuUseBackdrops checks menu-bar transparency and _HIWindowUseBackdrops. The latter depends on acceleration and reduced transparency.
_HIThemeApplyNewLook is an acceleration check in the inspected build, not a hidden design preference.

_HIMenuBarSetAppearanceOverride stores an appearance override and broadcasts theme/transparency changes. A nonzero override disables transparency in IsMenuBarTransparencyEnabled; _HIMenuBarGetAppearance normally chooses 1 for light and 2 for dark.
HIMenuBarOpaque is read from the application's Info dictionary; it is not established as a defaults key. Signed Info.plist files must remain intact.

HIToolbox's TThemeMetaFont constructs UI fonts through CTFontCreateUIFontForLanguage. SystemUIServer's CLKDigitalView.updatedFont: uses NSFont.systemFontOfSize: and font descriptors. These are separate paths to verify.
menuBar.nextSpike: In one isolated process, qualify the light appearance override and original CoreUI menu drawing together. Measure font metrics and cached font use separately. Process exit restores the override; avoid editing signed metadata.
menuBar.remaining: Disabling blur does not by itself establish Mavericks' background, logo, font or geometry.

legacyPreferences.confirmed: AppKit's _NSGetBoolAppConfig reads NSUserDefaults, honors the argument domain and caches the result. Per-process launch arguments are suitable for bounded qualification before any persistent defaults changes.

candidates.default: Compatibility exceptions for older QuickTime Player X and Pixelmator
Compatibility exception for older Final Cut

legacyPreferences.nextSpike: Compare each flag in a fresh process against native Mavericks metrics; do not enable the set globally or infer behavior from its name.

confirmed: The modern executable uses SPSearchPanel with separate defaultPositionOrigin, frame, collapse, saved-position and result-controller methods.

The linked Spotlight framework owns SPDefaults/SPAppDefaults. Inspected settings include search-source and suggestion controls; no complete classic-layout switch was identified in the inspected executable, defaults implementation or ParsecUI strings.
spotlight.nextSpike: Adapt the modern panel's placement, drawing, typography and result-row geometry while preserving the modern query and result controllers.
spotlight.qualification: The inspection does not prove that no hidden switch exists elsewhere in the system. No Spotlight presentation change has been applied.

deployment: No new appearance settings, shell restarts or runtime rendering changes were applied during this static pass. No attempt was made to unlock the experiment.
